objective_value: <float> Best scaling factor achieved across all reduction methods and target sizes.
one_stage_IP_mu: <dict, key: '{K}'> Results of one-stage scenario reduction with binary assignments for each target set size K.

one_stage_IP_mu.*.t: <float> Optimal scaling factor guaranteeing approximation quality of the reduced set.
one_stage_IP_mu.*.approximation_ratio: <float> Worst-case ratio of the true robust optimum to the optimum over the reduced set, equal to one over t.
one_stage_IP_mu.*.assignment: <dict, key: scenario index, value: aggregate index> Complete binary mu assignment, with every original scenario assigned to exactly one aggregate in 0..K-1.
one_stage_IP_mu.*.lambda_weights: <dict, key: aggregate index, value: dict[scenario index, float]> Sparse nonnegative convex-combination weights for every aggregate; omitted inner entries are zero.
one_stage_IP_mu.*.best_bound: <float> Gurobi objective bound for this subproblem.
one_stage_IP_mu.*.mip_gap: <float> Gurobi relative MIP gap for this subproblem.

two_stage_IP: <dict, key: '{K}'> Results of two-stage scenario reduction with scenario selection for each target set size K.

two_stage_IP.*.t: <float> Optimal scaling factor guaranteeing approximation quality of the selected scenarios.
two_stage_IP.*.approximation_ratio: <float> Worst-case ratio of the true robust optimum to the optimum over the selected scenarios, equal to one over t.
two_stage_IP.*.selected_scenarios: <list[int], length K> Indices of the original scenarios chosen to form the reduced set.
